source_candidates.role: Production: delayed intraday prices for UK and Indian 30-minute checks and a daily cross-check beside Twelve Data (owner, 2 and 3 Nov 2026). Daily closes come from Twelve Data.
Development only (owner, 2 Nov 2026): a US live sample beside synthetic fixtures; UK and India are trial symbols only on Basic; no /dividends or /splits.

source_candidates.selected_credit_option_note: Was null (pending); Grow 55 selected (owner, 2 Nov 2026). Pro 610 compared and not chosen.
source_candidates.uk_fund_nav_test: In the first paid month, test by API whether Grow 55 returns NAVs for each owner UK fund; uncovered funds are valued from the owner statements (owner, 3 Nov 2026).

source_candidates.role: Indian funds always; UK funds that the Grow 55 first-month test does not cover (owner, 3 Nov 2026). Imported through the controlled import and approval flow.

owner_decisions.decision: Per-listing/provider/plan use-right evidence and contract retention; no unknown grant enabled.
owner_decisions.note: Owner, 2 Nov 2026: no vendor is contacted; vendor evidence stays unknown and production rests on OWNER-RISK-01 (DATA-DEC-05).

owner_decisions.decision: Approve proposed close/NAV/FX freshness and cache/retry tolerances.
owner_decisions.note: Decides when a close, NAV, FX rate or 30-minute quote may be shown or used as current. Until the owner approves the proposed tolerances in DATA-06 and the cache/retry rules in DATA-07, none is used live. Evidence to check them against: the delays Grow 55 and Yahoo actually show in Grow 55's first month.

owner_decisions.decision: Actual holdings and fund share classes deferred; extend catalogue after owner supplies approved identifiers.
owner_decisions.note: Owner, 3 Nov 2026: Indian funds valued from the owner statements; UK funds by the Grow 55 first-month test, else statements (DATA-DEC-07, DATA-DEC-08).

owner_decisions.decision: Approve grant withdrawal treatment for datasets, backups, trained models and reproducibility records.
owner_decisions.note: Twelve Data's terms make a customer delete all data within 30 days of cancelling (terms 12.5(b), 16.2), keep audit-trail data for compliance and leave derived data with the customer (6.2); no vendor is asked to confirm how that applies to MP. The owner's answer decides what happens to stored bars, backups, trained models, forecasts and their audit records if Grow 55 ends (proposed: DATA-08 withdrawal treatment).

owner_decisions.decision: ARC-01 confirmed: Yahoo plus Twelve Data Grow 55 ($29 a month) in prod, Twelve Data Basic in dev; personal hobby use; the published-terms risk accepted (OWNER-RISK-01); no vendor contacted.
Yahoo stays for the UK and India: delayed intraday prices for the 30-minute checks and a cross-check beside Twelve Data end-of-day prices.
UK funds: test Grow 55 by API in its first month; if not covered, value UK funds from the owner statements.
Indian funds: valued from the owner holdings statements; all other market data from Twelve Data.
Gold and silver as XAU/USD and XAG/USD; top-5 segments US large caps, US tech, India Nifty 50, India midcap, ETFs (US, UK, India), commodities; no UK FTSE segment.
Discovery universe of about 150 curated names scanned on end-of-day data (the scan may add up to 5 GBP a month of Claude explanations; cost area).
Watch-only listings, markets and segments are added from chat: Claude proposes, code checks coverage and credits, the owner confirms in the app.

Does the accepted risk extend to sending provider values to Anthropic? Proposed: derived values plus the fewest raw values a route needs. Until answered, no risk_accepted record for anthropic_transmission.
owner_decisions.note: Decides whether any provider price may appear in a Claude prompt. Twelve Data's terms are silent on AI providers and forbid giving data to third parties without an agreement; Yahoo's terms bar transmitting any part of the service without written permission (s2(h)); Nasdaq's Data AI Policy needs a licence for third-party AI tools on Nasdaq data; no vendor is asked (owner, 2 Nov 2026). Until the owner answers, Claude routes receive no provider values.

owner_decisions.decision: Statement-valued funds: valuation and risk only, with no forecast task needing a daily series, until a verified daily NAV source exists (proposed).
owner_decisions.note: Indian funds, and any UK fund Grow 55 does not cover, are valued only from the owner's statements (DATA-DEC-07, DATA-DEC-08), which give one value per statement date, not a daily series. A forecast task needs a daily series, so without a verified daily NAV source these funds can show value and risk but no forecast.

owner_decisions.decision: Basic dev and Grow 55 prod are different plans and so different Twelve Data accounts; MP-10 did not check whether one person may hold a free Basic account beside a paid Grow account.
owner_decisions.note: If one person may not hold a free Basic account beside a paid Grow 55 account, dev either shares the Grow 55 account (its credits shared with prod, DATA-07) or runs on synthetic data only. Unchecked because no vendor is contacted; Twelve Data's terms or the first sign-up settle it.

owner_decisions.decision: Yahoo's accepted uses are narrowed to its selected role: delayed intraday quotes for the UK and India 30-minute checks, and daily values as a cross-check. Training and evaluation on Yahoo history is not covered (proposed).
owner_decisions.note: The owner selected Yahoo for intraday checks and a cross-check (DATA-DEC-06), not as a training source; Twelve Data closes are the training input. It matters if Grow 55's LSE, NSE or BSE history proves shorter than the 10-year similar-days lookback (checked in Grow 55's first month): filling the gap from Yahoo history needs the owner's yes.

owner_risk_acceptance.source: docs/planning/ma-reconciliation-2026-11-02/decision-log.md (Owner answers after the MP-10 source-rights research)
owner_risk_acceptance.scope: Yahoo Finance and Twelve Data (Grow 55 prod, Basic dev), the owner's personal hobby use, not commercial.
owner_risk_acceptance.accepted_risk: On published terms Yahoo forbids automated collection and Twelve Data labels Grow view-only (cannot be programmatically processed, stored, transformed or redistributed).
owner_risk_acceptance.effect: Runtime records decision risk_accepted with basis owner_risk_acceptance for the named uses; vendor cells stay unknown; no vendor is contacted; nothing is a grant.
never_covers: display or export to anyone other than the owner
owner_risk_acceptance.scope_rule: A use is risk_accepted only when a scope below names its source, plan, environment, data kind and listing; anything else falls to deny. No scope covers anthropic_transmission (DATA-DEC-12), redistribution, or display or export to anyone other than the owner. Derived display and export are to the owner only.

quota_allocation.correction: DATA-07 counted 20 action checks at weight 1 and assumed Basic could make them; /dividends and /splits weigh 20 per symbol each and need Grow (RES-DATA-13).

change_detection_mics.rule: Derived from the MICs of the catalogue's listings that can have corporate actions (spot pairs on XXXX have none); a new MIC from an addition (DATA-08) is added before its listing is enabled.
change_detection_mics.why_seven: US ETFs list on NYSE Arca (ARCX) or Cboe BZX (BATS), not only XNYS and XNAS; the fixed list of five missed them.

superseded_totals.reason: Counted a fixed five MICs; seven are needed once US ETFs on ARCX and BATS are polled (MP-20 round 2).

quota_allocation.live_proof: Account quota and every weight must be proven on the live account.
